description: This file contains instrumentation functions for various libraries and frameworks using OpenTelemetry, including FastAPI, Requests, HTTPX, Flask, SQLAlchemy, SQLite3, Redis, and placeholders for DB API and OpenAI. It defines functions to set up tracing hooks and instrument external modules for observability.

classes.name: InstrumentedClient
classes.description: Custom HTTPX client class that wraps the send method with tracing instrumentation.

classes.name: InstrumentedAsyncClient
classes.description: Custom HTTPX asynchronous client class that wraps the async send method with tracing instrumentation.

methods.name: _decode_body
methods.description: Decodes a request or response body from bytes to UTF-8 string if necessary.

methods.name: _instrument_fastapi
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for FastAPI, including request and response hooks.

methods.name: _instrument_requests
methods.description: Sets up OpenTelemetry instrumentation for the requests library with request and response hooks.

methods.name: _instrument_httpx
methods.description: Instruments the httpx library by replacing its Client and AsyncClient with traced versions.

methods.name: _instrument_flask
methods.description: Instruments Flask applications with OpenTelemetry, adding hooks for request start and end.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlalchemy
methods.description: Instruments SQLAlchemy to trace database queries, including special handling for SELECT statements.

methods.name: _instrument_dbapi
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting generic DB API; currently does nothing.

methods.name: _instrument_sqlite3
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting sqlite3; currently does nothing.

methods.name: _instrument_redis
methods.description: Instruments Redis client with request and response hooks for tracing commands.

methods.name: _instrument_openai
methods.description: Placeholder for instrumenting OpenAI API calls; currently does nothing.
